title: LaclauGPT Four-Layer Research Record
description: Project-wide record contract preserving raw capture, intermediate processing, canonical analysis and a human-readable researcher summary. The same logical record is projected to legacy-compatible CSV/dataframe/dashboard fields.

raw_capture.description: Exact received source/API/scraper material. At least one of payload or durable ref must preserve the original capture.

source.description: Normalized source/collection metadata while raw_capture retains the unmodified source material.

content.description: Normalized source-derived representations such as text, transcripts, OCR, frames and media references.

intermediate.description: Lossless stage outputs produced between raw collection and final analysis. Do not delete older stage outputs when a later stage succeeds.

analysis.description: Current structured LaclauGPT/NLP/LLM analysis. New fields are additive and must not overwrite raw/intermediate material.

human_readable.description: Researcher-facing deterministic summary covering source, intermediate results and analysis. This is in addition to analysis.summary.

legacy.description: Legacy aliases and imported values retained for round trips. Research exports derive stable EP24-style columns from canonical/intermediate data and merge non-conflicting imported values from here.
